tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta lha gnod sbyin chen po ku be ra yi bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod gcig dril rgyud mang po'i bcud bsdus yod/ 1$0000300badzra pā ṇi la na mo/

ku be ra mchod par 'dod pas/ gtor ma rin po che'i dbyibs can gcig byas la/ hūm̐/ mdun du gnod sbyin ku be ra// mdog nag go khrab rmog zhu can// sngon po chu ris chibs su 'chib// g.yas na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams// thugs ka'i 'od kyis spyan drangs gyur// byang phyogs skyong ba'i zhing khams nas// rnams sras thugs las sprul pa'i sras// ku be ra ni rdzu phrul can// gnod sbyin 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis mchod phyir spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol// rin chen khri mchog pad zla dang*// rta mchog brjid pa'i khri steng du// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas kyang*// sngon tshe thub pa'i dbang po dang*// gsang bdag dam tshig rjes dgongs la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ku be ra ya sa ma ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho tiṣṭha lhan/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri// sna tshogs zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs// 'dod yon sna lnga rin chen bdun// bkra shis rtag rdzas 'bru sman dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma 'bul// 'khor bcas mnyes shing tshims gyur cig /a kā ro sogs/ oṃ ku be ra ya sa pa ri wā ra i dam bha liṃ ta ghri hāntu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ ma ma sarba karma siddhi a mo ga swā hā/ arghaṃ sogs/ ku be ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon pas ne'u le g.yas pa na// ral gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi rta 'di srung skyob mdzod// bdag tu zungs la 'tsho bar gyis// gzhi byes lam gsum gar 'gro yang*// rta yi rdzi bo khyed kyis mdzod// gnod cing 'tshe ba ma gtang la// rta 'dre rtil sri'i kha khog cig / ces brjod la srab mda' bzhes pa'i tshul du bya/ rta'i rdzi bo byed par khas blangs par bsam/

thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la kaṃ yig gi mthar sngags g.yas su bskor bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥku be ra ya swā hā/ gho ra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ srungs shig / ces rta pho la srungs shig dang mo la spel cig sbyar ba brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o// 'di ni mgon po dngos grub 'byung rgyud dang*/ rnam sras rgyud nor bu 'byung ba dang*/ rta'i gzungs dang*/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mdzad pa'i cho ga dang*/ zangs dkar lugs kyi rnam sras cho ga sogs nas a rā gas bsdus pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
